hook: AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to feel less overwhelmed. I needed 3 things. Max.
caption:
AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to feel less overwhelmed. I needed 3 things. Max.

Here's the thing nobody talks about: AI doesn't know if you're a "give me the full roadmap" person or a "just tell me the next move" person.

So it defaults to thorough. Exhaustive. Comprehensive.

Which is genuinely useless if you think in sprints, not marathons.

This is the Momentum Thinker problem. You process by doing, not by planning. A 47-step framework doesn't motivate you — it paralyzes you. You need the smallest possible action that creates forward motion, and then you figure out the rest.

But ChatGPT doesn't know that about you. So every response reads like it was written for someone who color-codes their five-year plan.

When your AI profile knows you're a Momentum Thinker, the response changes completely:

→ Lead with action, not context
→ 3 options max, never 12
→ Skip the "here's why this works" preamble
→ End with ONE clear next step

Same question. Completely different answer. Because the AI finally knows who it's actually talking to.

Do you recognize yourself in this? Drop a 🏃 if you're a "just tell me what to do first" person.
